resources.string: Installs the cluster translation from a local ZIP. Check that the package matches the exact firmware version before backing up and installing.
Start with inspection. No vehicle write has been requested.

Park the vehicle and keep its power on throughout the operation. Four cluster files will be replaced after integrity and backup checks. The backup captures the state before our installation, which may already be modified. No process restart or reboot is performed. After a lost connection, inspect status before choosing recovery.
Operation in progress. If this remains after restarting the app, inspect the cluster state. Do not repeat installation blindly.
Operation did not complete normally. Inspect cluster status; use restore if required.
Backup verified on the cluster and copied to this app. Export a copy before installation.
Backup exported. Keep it outside the vehicle.
Files installed and verified. The running cluster has not been restarted. Hardware behavior has not yet been validated by this project.
